items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
items.summary: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

items.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
items.summary: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
items.summary: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.

items.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
items.summary: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

items.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
items.summary: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

items.title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in 'Impossible' Game
items.summary: Google’s Willow quantum processor beat the classical ceiling in a four-qubit coordination game, revealing a promising hardware test rather than commercial quantum computing.

items.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
items.summary: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

items.title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
items.summary: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

items.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
items.summary: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

items.title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
items.summary: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

items.title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Levent Alpöge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic’s IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

items.title: Kalshi faces Monday hearing on New York order it says would shut down its exchange nationwide
items.summary: Kalshi, which is headquartered in New York, has said the order would shut it down nationwide, though NY's AG said that's not her goal.

items.title: Cyber investigating suspected $1 million bridge exploit as Upbit, Bithumb freeze transfers
items.summary: South Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb both suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals, citing a suspected security incident.

items.title: Chainflip’s FLIP drops 34% after attacker drains $4.86 million from vault with suspected key compromise
items.summary: Chainflip's FLIP token dropped 34% in price in the wake of the apparently automated attack, per The Block's price data.

items.title: JPMorgan says bitcoin’s price drop pressures miners, Senate passes ‘Death Bets Act’, and more
items.summary: In today's newsletter, JPMorgan says bitcoin's price drop puts more pressure on miners; Senate passes bill to ban prediction markets tied to death and war; and more.

items.title: DCG’s Zcash miner Fortitude clears vote for Nasdaq listing as ZEC retreats from all-time high
items.summary: Fortitude wins shareholder backing for its planned Nasdaq debut as ZEC trades 55% below its record high.

items.title: Rep. Casten seeks to curb prediction market insider trading with DOJ whistleblower program
items.summary: Rep. Sean Casten, who could have a top spot in Congress next year, is clamping down on insider trading in prediction markets.

items.title: Deribit outage hit Bitcoin hedgers on Coinbase
items.summary: Two trading interruptions hit global Bitcoin and Ether perpetuals that share Deribit execution, while Coinbase said its US derivatives were unaffected. Read the full story on CryptoSlateUnderstand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox

items.title: Bitcoin’s next big threat could come from two oil tankers in the Middle East
items.summary: Two reported tanker strikes put the recent Brent decline to the test as traders watch outbound cargo and US rate expectations. Read the full story on CryptoSlateUnderstand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox

items.title: Bitcoin’s $60,000 breakdown puts December Fed decision under the spotlight
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 on Friday for the first time since July, with US spot Bitcoin funds recording withdrawals and short-term Treasury bills offering investors more than 4% a year. That creates a problem for the Federal Reserve's December meeting: traders expect a quarter-point rate increase, while Governor Christopher Waller has argued that persistent inflation… Read the full story on Crypt

items.title: Bitcoin shorts collapsed 79% in five weeks, then the market turned lower
items.summary: A drop of 3,889 reported short contracts drove most of the move, and the next CFTC report is due November 30. Read the full story on CryptoSlateUnderstand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox

items.title: Hackers replaced a DeepSeek model for 53 hours and stripped away its safety protections
items.summary: Prime Intellect says the substitute refused none of its HarmBench prompts, down from 198 of 240 with the original model. Read the full story on CryptoSlateUnderstand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox

items.title: Russia allows Bitcoin trading as sanctioned Moscow Exchange prepares December launch
items.summary: From Nov. 22, Russian exchanges can begin trading Bitcoin once the central bank approves the rules, but customers still can't use it to pay for anything. Moscow Exchange plans a Dec. 1 pilot through a US-sanctioned clearinghouse, with ordinary investors limited to 300,000 rubles in annual purchases per intermediary. The central bank's retail purchase rules… Read the full story on CryptoSlateUnders

items.title: Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom
items.summary: ▶Bitcoin Magazine Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom Tracy Shuchart says Bitcoin's biggest long-term argument is its monetary scarcity, but investors need to separate the long-term thesis from how it's trading today. This post Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green

items.title: Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5%
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5% The bitcoin price slipped to near $58,300 on Friday afternoon, briefly dipping under its summer low, as a chip-led selloff sent the Nasdaq down about 5% and dragged crypto stocks and miners sharply lower. This post Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine

items.title: MSTR Head of Investor Relations Addresses Bitcoin Pullback, Equity Performance
items.summary: ▶Bitcoin Magazine MSTR Head of Investor Relations Addresses Bitcoin Pullback, Equity Performance Chaitanya "CJ" Jain, Head of Investor Relations at Strategy, joins Bitcoin Magazine TV as Bitcoin trades below Strategy's average cost. This post MSTR Head of Investor Relations Addresses Bitcoin Pullback, Equity Performance first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green.

items.title: SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme The SEC obtained an asset freeze against Backward Hat Capital and its founders, alleging a $560 million Ponzi scheme sold as AI-driven FX trading funded through crypto. Prosecutors and the CFTC filed parallel cases. This post SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme first appeared on Bitcoin Magaz

items.title: Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal Blockstream researchers published a 131-page security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme for Bitcoin, and are asking the community to review it for flaws. This post Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal first appeared on Bitcoin M

items.title: U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Fed not to embrace a bigger rate hike as Citi and traders still see a quarter-point move in December and bitcoin fell below $60,000. This post U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

items.title: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins
items.summary: Quantum computers can’t break Bitcoin network’s security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
items.summary: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

items.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
items.summary: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

items.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
items.summary: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

items.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
items.summary: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

items.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
items.summary: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.
